argv:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$base='http://127.0.0.1:17448'
$s=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ($base+'/api/supervisor-watchdog?detect=0') -TimeoutSec 12
$q=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ($base+'/api/supervisor-watchdog/agent-assignments') -TimeoutSec 12
$st=Get-Content -LiteralPath 'E:\WebAIBridge\app\data\state.json' -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
Write-Output ('AUTONOMOUS_SEND_ALLOWED='+$s.config.allowAutonomousSend)
Write-Output ('AUTO_CONTINUE='+$s.config.autoContinueEnabled)
Write-Output ('QUEUE_PAUSED='+$st.settings.paused)
Write-Output ('ASSIGNMENT_COUNT='+@($q.assignments).Count)
Write-Output ('UNSETTLED='+@($q.assignments|Where-Object{$_.state -in @('queued','dispatching','running','awaiting_evidence','unknown')}).Count)
Write-Output ('PRODUCTION_HEAD='+(& git.exe -C 'E:\WebAIBridge' rev-parse HEAD))
Write-Output ('BACKUP_EXISTS='+(Test-Path -LiteralPath 'E:\WebAIBridge-R65-SAFETY-BACKUP-20261014-GPT6-I1\BACKUP_MANIFEST.json'))
